title: Spindle Load — Upper Advisory Threshold
description: Spindle load P002 = {val}% is above upper advisory band (70%) but below major threshold. Sustained for {val2} minutes.
probable_cause: Normal heavy-cut condition or early tool wear. Monitor for progression.
diagnostic_steps: Verify programmed depth of cut is nominal
remedy: No immediate action. Log and monitor trend.
required_action: Log fault. Monitor parameters. Schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.
escalation_path: If SPN-MN-001 is not addressed (log fault. monitor parameters. schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.), the fault will escalate in this order: SPN-MD-001, then SPN-SR-001. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
